records.text: Andrew Kolvet called Thomas Massie's office on March 12, 2026, profusely apologized for a TPUSA video labeling Massie a RINO, blamed an excited 20-year-old intern, said TPUSA would not enter the race, and personally wanted Massie to win.
records.speaker: Raphael Schreber

appearances.snippet: Andrew Kolvet, didn't you call our office a few months ago on March 12, 2026, to be exact, profusely apologizing for TPUSA posting a video of Thomas Massie labeling him a rhino that you blamed on some 20-year-old TPUSA intern that was excited about Jake Paul and that you would have never allowed it? ... Didn't you ask us to express your sincerest apologies to Massie, and that TPUSA was not going to get involved with the race, but that you personally wanted Massie to win?

verification.notes: Massie legislative director Rafael Schreiber publicly posted the detailed allegation, which the episode accurately reads. No recording, contemporaneous memo, or acknowledgment from Kolvet independently proves the underlying call and statements.

sources.title: The World is a Stage; Trump Survives transcript
sources.relevance: The source episode captures the detailed allegation attributed to Massie legislative director Rafael Schreiber; no recording of the underlying call or Kolvet acknowledgment was located.
